reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT b.buyer_id,COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM buyers b LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.buyer_id=b.buyer_id AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY b.buyer_id ORDER BY b.buyer_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT b.buyer_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.buyer_id=b.buyer_id AND o.status='completed') AS completed_orders FROM buyers b ORDER BY b.buyer_id
